title: Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
  • Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
  • Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
  • Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
  • Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
  • Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
  • Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
  • Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
  • Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
  • Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
  • Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
  • Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
  • Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
  • Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
  • Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
  • Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
  • Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento).
  • Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança).
  • Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados).
  • Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions).
  • Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas).
  • Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos).
  • Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards).
  • Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio).

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Application Security Engineer with 5+ years of experience to help strengthen the security posture of the software platforms. This role will be responsible for reviewing application code, identifying security vulnerabilities, and working closely with development teams to ensure secure coding practices are followed throughout the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will have strong experience in application penetration testing, fraud detection and analysis, and secure software development practices. This individual will play a key role in proactively identifying risks in PHP, Python, and Angular applications, while also educating development teams on secure coding standards and best practices.


Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct regular security assessments, code reviews, and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in applications and software, including manual and automated code reviews for applications written in PHP, Python, and Angular
  • Analyze applications for common vulnerabilities such as those identified in the OWASP Top 10, including risks related to authentication, authorization, data validation, and session management
  • Conduct application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on web applications and APIs, simulating real-world attack scenarios to uncover security weaknesses and documenting findings with recommended mitigation strategies
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies
  • Track, analyze, and manage vulnerabilities in applications while providing guidance and support for remediation efforts
  • Analyze application behavior and transaction patterns to detect potential fraud or abuse scenarios and identify vulnerabilities that could enable account takeover, payment fraud, or data manipulation
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to design controls that reduce fraud risk.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including developing secure coding guidelines, delivering secure coding training, and providing guidance during design and architecture reviews
  • Design, develop, and implement security tools, frameworks, and methodologies to protect applications against security threats, including integrating and maintaining security testing tools such as SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning within CI/CD pipelines
  • Assist in investigating, analyzing, and responding to security incidents related to applications, ensuring timely resolution and documentation of incidents
  • Track vulnerabilities and remediation progress through internal ticketing systems while collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to improve the overall application security posture and assist in developing internal security policies and procedures


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or secure software development
  • Strong understanding of web application security principles and the OWASP Top 10
  • Experience reviewing code in PHP, Python, and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular
  • Experience performing application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure session management
  • Experience identifying and mitigating fraud or abuse patterns in applications
  • Familiarity with common security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube, etc.)
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security issues to non-security engineers


Desired Experience:

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with cloud security principles
  • Experience with secure architecture reviews
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GWAPT, or CSSLP
  • Experience working in agile development environments


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Paid Media Specialist
description:
We are a DTC Growth Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses grow profitably.


Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated.

- Pay close attention to detail.

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.

- Have the confidence and determination to achieve our shared vision.


Who We Are Looking For:


We are looking for an ecommerce Paid Media Specialist who has experience managing large ad budgets across Meta and Google primarily. (Ideally over 1 million dollars USD per month). Additionally, if you experience using MTAs such as NorthBeam, incrementality testing tools, and MMM tools for data validation that is a major plus.


The candidate selected for this role would come in and manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts for US based ecommerce brands. We have a lot of high-profile ecommerce clients that we work with and we are looking for a seasoned Paid Media Specialist who can produce high quality results for our clients.


The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands.


Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads.


Responsibilities

  • Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands
  • Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok
  • Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients
  • Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of
  • Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps
  • Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness
  • Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses)
  • Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred
  • Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands
  • Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients
  • Autonomous worker with an analytical mind
  • Portfolio of work, results, or case studies
  • You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not.
  • You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that.


Compensation:

  • $2000 - $8000 USD per month


Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.

title: Analista de E-mail Marketing
description:
• ANALISTA DE E-MAIL MARKETING


Atividades:

  • Criar estratégias de retenção de usuários em nossos canais de comunicação (Active Campaign / Clevertap);
  • Planejamento estratégico de E-mail, WhatsApp, SMS ou Push com impacto direto em volumetria, frequência e níveis de engajamento de diferentes, sempre visando impacto positivo na receita;
  • Criar/otimizar templates de e-mails atraentes e gerenciar ciclo de envios;

  • Realizar análises regulares dos resultados das campanhas, identificando áreas de melhoria e oportunidades para otimização;
  • Contato com Postmaster de provedores para mitigação de IP;
  • Entrega de relatórios semanais detalhados com indicadores e desempenho;

  • Experiência prévia em E-mail Marketing / CRM
  • Domínio de métricas, segmentação e análise de campanhas
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de automação (Active Campaign/Clevertap).
  • Noções de IA aplicadas ao CRM

  • Contrato PJ
  • Trabalho 100% Home Office
  • Descanso Remunerado
  • Acesso à plataforma de cursos para desenvolvimento contínuo

title: Product Marketing Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own our product-led growth in partnership with our product team — someone who knows how to move the needle and own their outcomes.


About us:


Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive — this isn’t the role for you.


But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own


  • Drive our PLG initiatives by building campaigns that increase conversions, engagement, retention, upgrades, and cross-sells.
  • Own in-app messaging using tools like AppCues to onboard, convert, and activate users
  • Write high-impact messaging, value propositions, and product comparison landing pages that drive inbound conversion
  • Own and optimize in-app customer self-onboarding — reduce time-to-value, increase sign-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion rates
  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to align go-to-market efforts and drive measurable growth
  • Execute product launches and campaigns leading up to it, and bring a successful playbook you can leverage.
  • Build and manage internal and external product knowledge bases and communications for product updates
  • Be an active contributor in the development and management of customer advocacy programs such as user referral and/or affiliate programs.
  • Track campaign performance and report KPIs with precision — weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly
  • Partner with our success team to collect customer feedback through surveys, direct customer communications, and beta groups, and use it to create user stories and case studies.
  • Document campaign playbooks, and external and internal product trainings, using video (Loom), and upload to Trainual

title: Product Owner - Sênior
description:
Product Owner - Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Você liderará cerimônias ágeis e garantirá a entrega contínua de valor, promovendo melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto.
  • Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto.
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.
  • Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio.
  • Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo “mão na massa”, orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs).
  • Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital.

title: Analista de Growth Pleno — Jornada do Cliente & Conversão (ChatBot WhatsApp)
description:
Vaga para modelo de contratação PJ


Remoto


A ConCrédito é uma das maiores correspondentes bancárias do Brasil, especializada em crédito consignado nas modalidades CLT, INSS e FGTS. Com mais de 300 mil clientes atendidos via WhatsApp, a ConCrédito preza pelo bom atendimento e pela experiência do cliente, comprovados pelas mais de 21 mil avaliações positivas no Google Meu Negócio.


O Papel

O Analista de Growth Pleno será o principal responsável pela jornada do cliente no chatbot do WhatsApp, o maior canal de aquisição e relacionamento da empresa. A missão é clara: reduzir atrito, combater o abandono e maximizar o Lifetime Value (LTV) da base de leads e clientes.


Responsabilidades

  • Mapear e otimizar o funil conversacional de ponta a ponta, identificando gargalos nas micro e macroconversões.
  • Rodar testes A/B contínuos em mensagens, copywriting, timing de follow-ups e arquitetura dos fluxos.
  • Criar e gerir réguas de relacionamento, ativação de leads frios e campanhas de reengajamento.
  • Auxiliar na construção de dashboards de acompanhamento da jornada em parceria com o time de Dados (Snowflake, Power BI).
  • Refinar clusters de audiência para personalização em escala.
  • Atuar de forma cross-functional com os times de Marketing, Vendas, BI e Produto/Tech.


KPIs sob sua gestão

  • Ativação: taxa de ativação de leads recém-chegados ao chatbot.
  • Conversão do funil: eficiência na passagem entre etapas do fluxo conversacional.
  • Taxa de abandono: redução de drop-off em cada estágio da jornada.
  • Time-to-convert: redução do tempo médio para contratação efetiva.
  • Retenção e recompra: aumento do LTV e da frequência de uso dos serviços.
  • ROI de campanhas: retorno sobre campanhas de repescagem e disparos via WhatsApp.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Capacidade técnica de uso ou criação de agentes de IA, independentemente da ferramenta ou framework (Claude, Manus, Antigravity…).
  • Experiência sólida como Analista de Growth, CRO, Lifecycle Marketing, CRM ou Produto, com foco em conversão.
  • Capacidade analítica avançada: métricas de funil, análise de cohort, LTV e CAC.
  • Vivência prática com otimização de chatbots, automação de mensagens e WhatsApp API oficial.
  • Domínio de frameworks de growth hacking e testes A/B.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  • Boa comunicação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócios.


Diferenciais valorizados

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, mercado de crédito ou operações B2C com alto volume de leads.
  • Conhecimento na plataforma ColmeIA ou chats conversacionais similares.
  • Habilidades em SQL e ferramentas como Metabase ou Supabase.
  • Familiaridade com IA aplicada à personalização de fluxos conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em automação com N8N.


Essa vaga NÃO é para você se:

  • Você é mais executor do que estrategista e não tem experiência otimizando funis de conversão.
  • Sua experiência está focada em social media, branding ou marketing de conteúdo.
  • Você trabalha apenas com análise de dados, sem transformar insights em ações práticas.
  • Sua atuação em growth é mais teórica do que prática (cursos, conceitos, pouca execução real).
  • Você nunca lidou com alto volume de leads ou operações em escala.
  • Seu foco é apenas aquisição (tráfego pago) e não conversão ao longo da jornada.
  • Você não tem experiência com chatbots, automação de mensagens ou fluxos conversacionais.
  • Você precisa de direcionamento constante e não tem autonomia para testar, iterar e tomar decisões.

title: Especialista em Branding
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?

Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Especialista em Branding , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Marketing e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.



Responsabilidades


  • Liderar e apoiar o desenvolvimento do Brand System da SuperFrete (brandbook, tom de voz, diretrizes visuais e narrativas, em todos os canais da marca incluindo redes sociais, endomarketing e assessoria de imprensa);
  • Garantir a consistência da identidade da marca em todos os pontos de contato;
  • Criar guidelines, playbooks e briefings estratégicos para campanhas e conteúdos;
  • Acompanhar cronogramas, entregas e qualidade das iniciativas de branding;
  • Conduzir análises de mercado, auditorias de marca e acompanhamento de indicadores de branding;
  • Criar e conduzir workshops de marca para equipes internas e novas lideranças;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com diferentes áreas e squads para garantir a aplicação correta das diretrizes da marca;
  • Conduzir a evolução do posicionamento da marca, identificando oportunidades no ecossistema de e-commerce, logística e empreendedorismo;
  • Liderar iniciativas estratégicas de branding e gerenciar relacionamento com agências, consultorias e parceiros criativos;
  • Planejar a presença da marca em eventos do setor, garantindo experiências alinhadas ao posicionamento da SuperFrete;
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento da cultura de marca e marca empregadora dentro da organização.
  • Liderar a estratégia de PR e relacionamento com imprensa, identificando oportunidades de exposição institucional da marca.



Requisitos


  • Ensino superior completo em Publicidade e Propaganda, Jornalismo, Marketing ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência na gestão e aplicação de Brand Systems (brandbook, diretrizes visuais e tom de voz);
  • Conhecimento em pesquisas de marca, análise de mercado e concorrência;
  • Experiência em projetos de branding ou rebranding;
  • Capacidade de definir, planejar e executar estratégias de marca;
  • Habilidade para identificar tendências de mercado e comportamento do consumidor;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de storytelling e excelente habilidade de escrita;
  • Capacidade de transitar entre diferentes contextos, projetos e stakeholders;
  • Olhar crítico para identidade visual e revisão de peças (texto e design);
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos e iniciativas de marca simultaneamente.



Diferenciais


  • Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos, como startups ou empresas em processo de expansão;
  • Experiência com produção de eventos corporativos;
  • Experiência com assessoria de imprensa.



O que você pode esperar dos Supers?


  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.

title: Remote Healthcare and Social Assistance Expert - 65107
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

We are looking for healthcare domain experts (5+ years experience) to create real-world, profession-based prompts and tasks. The role involves creating high quality prompts and documents to evaluate model responses on day-to-day work in healthcare, clinical, and administrative settings.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Create realistic, first-person prompts based on actual job workflows
  • Design tasks that reflect real-world healthcare and clinical scenarios
  • Select and use relevant public data/documents as input files

We are open to many experts within healthcare (including but not limited to): Registered Nurses, First-Line Supervisors of Office/Admin Support, Medical & Health Services Managers, Nurse Practitioners, Medical Secretaries & Administrative Assistants.


Terms of Contract :

  • Opportunity is for a project that is ~2 week duration with potential extension


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Consultor(a) SAP SuccessFactors Compensation SR
description:
Somos a SEIDOR, multinacional de tecnologia e inovação, que oferece um portfólio completo de soluções e serviços para promover a competitividade e a transformação das organizações. São mais de 40 anos acreditando na tecnologia , com 85 escritórios e uma equipe de mais de 7.500 profissionais na Europa, América Latina, Estados Unidos, África, Oriente Médio e Ásia.


Somos parceiros platinum da SAP e temos mais de 8.500 clientes . Nosso portfólio completo é voltado para empresas grandes, médias e em crescimento. Na SEIDOR acreditamos que, para enfrentar os novos desafios do mundo digital, devemos ter os melhores aliados, as tecnologias líderes de mercado e, acima de tudo, as melhores pessoas.


Nós acreditamos no valor das pessoas . Buscamos constantemente atrair e reter talentos, investindo no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e oferecendo oportunidades de crescimento profissional. Nosso time é composto por profissionais colaborativos, autônomos e ágeis que juntos formam um ambiente de trabalho desafiador, dinâmico e sem discriminação, respeitando as diferenças que nos tornam mais humanos.


✨ Venha fazer parte desse novo projeto! ✨

Tem os requisitos abaixo? Então essas vagas são para você ! ✨

  • Consultor(a) SAP SuccessFactors Compensation SR


Sobre a oportunidade:

  • Atuar em projetos de implementação e/ou rollout do módulo Compensation do SAP SuccessFactors, do Blueprint ao Go-live/Hypercare.
  • Conduzir workshops de levantamento de requisitos (AS-IS/TO-BE) com RH e TI para desenho do processo de recrutamento e seleção.
  • Elaborar desenho de solução e documentação funcional (ex.: mapeamentos, decisões, regras e fluxos do processo seletivo).
  • Configurar e parametrizar o Recruiting conforme escopo do projeto, incluindo: job requisitions e templates de requisição; processos seletivos, estágios e status; formulários de candidatura e campos customizados; workflows de aprovação, e-mails e notificações; regras de elegibilidade e roteamento de candidatos; Apoiar o desenho e execução de testes (SIT/UAT), incluindo preparação de cenários, suporte a usuários-chave, registro de evidências e correção de defeitos.
  • Apoiar cutover e atividades de go-live, garantindo prontidão do processo (configurações finais, validações e comunicações de mudança).
  • Realizar troubleshooting de processos, regras e possíveis impactos de integrações relacionadas ao Recruiting, em conjunto com times técnicos quando necessário; Produzir e manter documentação do projeto (roteiros de teste, guias rápidos, materiais de treinamento e apoio à adoção).
  • Orientar e treinar key users, recrutadores e gestores durante o projeto, apoiando a gestão de mudanças.
  • Interagir com áreas de negócio, TI e fornecedores para alinhar dependências, riscos e decisões de desenho.
  • Garantir aderência do Recruiting às políticas e processos de RH do cliente e às melhores práticas SAP.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP SuccessFactors – Compensation, com atuação relevante em projetos de implementação/rollout;
  • Conhecimento sólido em configuração do Compensation: planos (merit, bonus, LTIP), eligibility, guidelines, proration, workflows e regras de cálculo;
  • Experiência com levantamento de requisitos e desenho de processos de compensação e remuneração;
  • Vivência com testes (SIT/UAT), suporte a usuários-chave e tratativa de defeitos;
  • Familiaridade (ao menos funcional) com integrações do SuccessFactors (ex.: Integration Center, APIs, conectores) e capacidade de apoiar análise de falhas;
  • Capacidade de elaborar documentação funcional/técnica (solution design, mapeamentos, roteiros e evidências);
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, organização e trabalho em equipe.


Desejável:

  • Certificação SAP SuccessFactors Compensation;
  • Conhecimento em outros módulos (ex.: Employee Central, PMGM, Variable Pay);
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado;
  • Participação em projetos de integração Compensation × PMGM e Compensation × EC;
  • Experiência com LTIP (Long Term Incentive Plans) e planos complexos de remuneração variável;
  • Habilidade para conduzir workshops e ministrar treinamentos (funcionais e para usuários).

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Native Teams is a global platform for work payments and employment. Beyond managing payroll, compliance, and taxes, we integrate financial tools to maximise the value of every work payment, worldwide.


We are expanding our global team and looking for a Business Development Manager to bring their wider knowledge and help us get our product and service more widely known and used.


In this role, you will play a key role in driving new business and revenue growth by managing the full sales cycle from outbound outreach to discovery, solution design, negotiation, and closing. You will work closely with prospective clients to understand their needs, educate them on Native Teams' solutions, and guide them through the decision-making and onboarding process. Your goal is to acquire new customers and expand revenue within assigned markets and ICPs.


Would you like to take on a new challenge in the field of sales in a successful, fast-growing global start-up?


Location: Remote

Salary range: Flexible


Key Responsibilities


Outbound & Pipeline Generation

  • Proactively identify and engage prospective clients through outbound outreach, networking, events, and other channels.
  • Execute outbound strategies tailored to defined ICPs and market segments.
  • Research accounts for understanding business context, hiring plans, and potential use cases.


Inbound Handling

  • Take qualified inbound requests and convert them into active opportunities.
  • Respond promptly and professionally in line with internal SLAs.
  • Run a structured qualification to assess fit and readiness.


Discovery & Consultative Selling

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls to understand client goals, blockers, compliance considerations, and service requirements.
  • Educate prospects on how Native Teams supports global employment, payroll, and work payments.
  • Present tailored solutions, product overviews, and value propositions to multiple stakeholders.


Solution Design & Pricing

  • Prepare proposals, pricing scenarios, and competitive a/b options in line with commercial guidelines.
  • Guide clients on hiring models (EoR, Contractor of Record, etc.) and explain operational processes.
  • Work cross-functionally to ensure feasibility for legal, product, and finance-related questions.


Negotiation & Closing

  • Manage contract negotiations and commercial discussions through to signature.
  • Navigate procurement timelines, internal approvals, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Close new business and achieve monthly/quarterly revenue targets.


Pipeline Ownership & Forecasting

  • Maintain an up-to-date sales pipeline with accurate stage management and forecasting.
  • Log all activities, updates, and communication history in the CRM.
  • Prioritize high-impact opportunities while balancing follow-ups and nurturing.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and Product teams to ensure a smooth client transition post-close.
  • Relay client feedback to internal stakeholders to support product and process improvements.
  • Represent the sales voice in outbound campaigns, ICP targeting, and revenue initiatives.


Market Feedback & Learning

  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitive offerings, and compliance developments.
  • Share insights from the market to improve positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.



Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
  • Experience in outbound sales, B2B sales, or full-cycle sales roles.
  • Strong communication and client-facing presentation skills.
  • Confident running discovery calls, demos, and negotiations.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot) and sales outreach tools.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deals in parallel.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, work autonomously, and drive outcomes.
  • Fluency in English, written and spoken.



Benefits


  • Dynamic and interesting work in an early-stage, funded startup.
  • Ability to influence the next stages of our growth.
  • Experience working in the ever-changing world of FinTech.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.
  • Flexible work environment.



Join our team at Native Teams, a fast-growing global start-up. We're looking for driven, passionate individuals to join us as we continue to expand our reach and impact.


At Native Teams, we pride ourselves on our dynamic and supportive work environment, where we encourage personal and professional growth. We believe in hiring talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, not only because we should do it but because fresh perspectives improve our team and our decisions. Our multicultural team is made up of young, energetic, and positive people who are passionate about what they do.


As part of our team, you’ll reflect the people we serve and will have the opportunity to work with thousands and impact millions of lives around the world.


If you're looking for a challenging and rewarding career and the chance to be part of a team that's making a real difference in the world, then we want to hear from you.


Apply now to join the Native Teams family and take the first step toward a brighter future!

title: Market Intelligence Manager - Americas
description:
Summary of Job Duties


Ensure their regional team fulfils the roles and responsibilities of:

Customer development

  • Lead opportunity assessment: proactively engage in customer development, leverage marketing intelligence capability to assess customer opportunity, generate customer leads from current or potential opportunities driving from new developed product and formulation.
  • Customer development action plan: proactively engage in action plan formulation, and engage in customer communication and execution
  • Customer solution proposal: coordinate external resources to design customized market service plan based on customer’s need

Customer relationship management

  • Proactively engage in relationship mgmt. with KA’s marketing related departments, gathering market insights to support R&D and BD

Marketing service:

  • Delivery & after-sales: responsible for leveraging internal capability and external resources to deliver marketing service and after-sales


Main Responsibilities


Although the position is a management role the candidate also expected to be hands on and involved wherever required for the regional team to carry out the following responsibilities:


  • Market Research

To visit customer site with sales and also collect market information in their region such as:

  • Customer Survey Analysis
  • Customer service needs/opportunities
  • Customer’s org chart
  • Customer’s end consumer insights and trends
  • Prospects and opportunity analysis
  • Category Analysis
  • Sales Channels
  • Competitive landscape


  • Marketing Support Service

Help promote, drive and expand our added value service to our customers to provide them with our 360 marketing solution

  • Market Research/Business Intelligence
  • Receipe support
  • `zSales distribution


  • Account Based Marketing

Will be responsible to perform research to find high-value accounts to target as well as spend time developing growth strategies from their findings. They will ensure marketing activities line up with strategies developed and ultimately translate plans to the sales team for execution. They need to ensure the follow steps are covered:

  • Identify high-value target accounts – Identify key accounts that have the potential to contribute the most to the revenue of your company.
  • Conduct research on those accounts - Get a good snapshot of customer needs and pain points, as well as where they are in their customer journey.
  • Develop customized marketing campaigns - Using information you learned in the research phase to inform your strategy, develop creative assets that will resonate with the target account.
  • Run customized marketing campaigns - Launch your campaigns to the target account.
  • Measure customized marketing campaigns - Analyze the data to see how your campaigns are performing.


  • Online Marketing

Will be in charge of creating localized content regularly update the following marketing channels in their assigned region.

  • Webinars
  • SEO – Quarterly updates on the regional assigned webpage
  • Social media – Weekly updates on social media platforms in where they are based – language will depend on where they are based
  • Email marketing – Monthly articles that can be distributed for sales use in their regions.


  • Offline Marketing

Will handle the planning and implementation of offline marketing tasks in the assigned region which could cover

  • Exhibitions
  • Roadshows
  • Print (Quarterly updates)
  • PowerPoint presentations (Company introductions, products or service introductions)


  • Public Relations
  • Build up media relations and ‘Distribution Media List’ for future press release distribution in their assigned region.
  • Ensure appearance on at least one reputable news website in their assigned region.


Qualifications (Education/Knowledge/Working Experience)


  • Master’s degree in a Marketing related discipline.
  • Around 10 years of experience
  • Knowledgable in hands on B2B2C marketing as well as the consumer market in the beverage industry.


Skills Needed


Market Research and Analysis: The ability to conduct thorough market research, analyze data, and draw actionable insights is crucial for understanding the target market, consumer behavior, and industry trends.

Strategic Planning: Regional Marketing Managers must be adept at developing and executing marketing strategies that align with overall business objectives. This includes setting clear goals, defining KPIs, and creating actionable plans.

Team Leadership and Management: Effective leadership skills are important for managing and motivating a team of marketing professionals. This includes providing guidance, setting expectations, and facilitating collaboration.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Regional Marketing Managers need to work closely with various departments like sales, product development, and supply chain to ensure that marketing initiatives are aligned with overall business operations.

Brand Management: They should have the ability to maintain and enhance the brand image in the specified region. This involves ensuring consistency in messaging, visual identity, and customer experience.

Campaign Management: This skill involves planning, executing, and optimizing marketing campaigns. It requires the ability to set clear objectives, target the right audience, and measure the effectiveness of campaigns.

Budget Management: Effective allocation and management of marketing budgets are essential for maximizing return on investment (ROI) and ensuring that resources are used efficiently.

Data Analysis and Interpretation: Proficiency in using data analytics tools to measure campaign performance, track key metrics, and derive actionable insights is crucial for making informed marketing decisions.

Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills are necessary for conveying marketing messages effectively to various stakeholders, including team members, executives, and external partners.

Adaptability and Flexibility: The ability to adapt to changing market conditions, consumer preferences, and industry trends is vital for staying competitive and achieving long-term success.

Problem-Solving Skills: Regional Marketing Managers should be able to identify challenges and develop creative solutions to overcome them. This includes being resourceful and thinking critically.

Cultural Awareness and Sensitivity: Especially in a regional role, understanding and respecting cultural nuances and preferences is important for tailoring marketing strategies to specific markets.

Time Management: Effectively prioritizing tasks and managing time to meet deadlines is essential in a fast-paced marketing environment.

Tech-Savviness: Familiarity with marketing technology tools and platforms, as well as proficiency in relevant software and applications, is important for executing marketing initiatives efficiently.

Negotiation Skills: The ability to negotiate and build partnerships with external stakeholders, such as agencies, vendors, and media outlets, can be crucial for successful marketing campaigns.

title: QA Engineer
description:
Senior QA Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil. Based)

Reports to: QA Engineer Senior

Type: Full-time

Salary : Competitive open to negotiate payment USD

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to join our growing technology team for an important Fintech Crypto Company. This role is crucial in ensuring the quality, performance, and reliability of our software products.

You will be responsible for executing manual and automated tests, identifying and documenting issues, and creating test scenarios aligned with business and technical requirements. You’ll also contribute to improving QA processes, CI/CD integration, and leveraging AI technologies to enhance automation efficiency and coverage.

This is a hands-on position — ideal for someone who enjoys both technical testing and process improvement , and who thrives in a collaborative, Agile environment.

⚙️ Key Responsibilities

  • Execute manual and automated tests to ensure software quality and performance.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases based on business requirements.
  • Create and manage functional and regression tests across multiple platforms.
  • Identify, document, and track issues and inconsistencies; collaborate with developers for timely resolution.
  • Support and promote best quality assurance practices within the development team.
  • Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline to support continuous delivery.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve QA processes, tools, and methodologies .
  • Provide clear reporting on testing progress, risks, and software quality metrics.
  • Utilize AI-based tools to enhance test creation, automation scripting, and defect detection.
  • Collaborate closely with product owners, developers, and stakeholders to ensure alignment with user expectations.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, with 2+ years in automation testing.
  • Proven experience in manual and automated testing within an Agile environment.
  • Strong background in designing and executing detailed test plans and defect management .
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD workflows .

Technical Skills

  • Advanced English level (C1 ).
  • Proficiency with testing frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright .
  • Familiarity with AI tools for generating or optimizing test scripts.
  • Experience with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner).
  • Understanding of REST APIs, SQL , and general software testing methodologies.
  • Knowledge of Agile/Scrum practices and ability to collaborate in iterative development cycles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Playwright .
  • Exposure to AI-based test automation or intelligent test generation tools.
  • Experience with cloud-based environments and microservices testing.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools .

Why Join Us

  • Work with cutting-edge QA and AI technologies in a fast-paced environment.
  • Join a collaborative, innovation-driven engineering culture .
  • Competitive compensation and long-term growth opportunities .
  • Opportunity to contribute to high-impact, scalable software solutions .

description:

  • SAP S/4HANA Finance certification is a plus.

Hands-on experience building reports and dashboards in Microsoft Power BI.

title: Digital Content Producer
description:
DesignRush.com, a B2B Media Platform that drives brand discovery & growth, is seeking a Digital Content Producer to scale visual production and improve the performance of editorial content through stronger visual storytelling.

Our platform offers four key values to users:

  • Trending Brands: Brands can feature their expertise and achievements via news, interviews, and trends articles to get noticed and recognized as an industry leader.
  • Agency Rankings: Brands can view qualified agencies based on their expertise, location, clients, and various other factors.
  • Awards: Brands can enter their finest work and compete for the best web logo, app, print, packaging, and video design awards.
  • Marketplace: Businesses can post their projects at no cost and receive proposals from verified agencies.

The person in this role will be responsible for driving:

  • Production Scale and Publishing Efficiency: Produce and publish high-volume editorial content by creating and sourcing images, building infographics/motion graphics, formatting stories in the CMS, and maintaining quality and brand consistency.
  • Visual Performance and Conversion Impact: Improve article performance by creating visuals that reinforce the key message of each story and remain consistent with the brand identity, supported by optimized templates and motion/infographic enhancements.

We offer GROWTH, job stability, and a work culture that enables our teammates to excel in their careers.

This is for a full-time, remote-work-at-home position.

DesignRush is seeking to make IMMEDIATE hires.

Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end story production (create/source visuals, infographic/motion builds, and CMS publishing) to support ~40 stories per week
  • Serve as the primary visual production point of contact for the content team, collaborating cross-functionally with dev, marketing, sales and digital PR, and collaborating with the head designer on template improvements and larger-scale design updates.
  • Continuously improve visual systems, templates and workflows to increase efficiency and engagement
  • Provide visual asset support across newsletters, digital PR, sales, and PTO coverage as needed

Required qualifications:

  • Over 5 years of proven hands-on experience in digital content production, visual storytelling, or editorial production roles .
  • Proven ability to manage high-volume publishing environments (30–40+ pieces of content per week).
  • Strong experience creating visual assets for editorial content , including Infographics, Data visualizations, Basic motion graphics or animated visuals, Image sourcing and editing
  • Proficiency with design and production tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects), or equivalent tools.
  • Experience publishing content in CMS platforms, including formatting, asset management, and QA.
  • Strong understanding of visual storytelling for digital media and SEO-driven content .
  • Experience working with design agencies or the creative industry
  • Strong understanding of marketing, branding, and digital agencies
  • Excellent written and oral English communication skills
  • Goal-oriented individual
  • Strong ability to strategize and solve problems
  • Able to work between 6 AM and 3 PM EST

Recruitment steps:

  • Apply via LinkedIn
  • Receive a short questionnaire
  • Send back answers + CV
  • Have an interview with our Recruiter
  • Technical Test
  • Hiring Manager and our General Manager
  • Get feedback

title: Marketing Operations Manager (with Marketo)
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

We’re seeking a Marketing Operations Manager to own and evolve our Marketo ecosystem. This role will take full responsibility for the platform, improve how it’s structured and used, and partner closely with our Marketing team and Salesforce Admin to drive scalable, reliable execution. This person will immediately stabilize and improve the system, while enabling others on the team to operate more effectively.

Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. title: Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases
description:
Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases


Location: Ukraine, Armenia, Moldova, Brazil(Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Data Engineer to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


About the Role


We're hiring a Senior DBA to own the database layer across our production systems — OLTP relational databases as the operational store and an OLAP columnar database for analytics. Data flows between them via a CDC pipeline (Debezium → Kafka) managed by our infrastructure team. You'll own what's on both ends: schema design, data modeling, query performance, and analytics enablement.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll be the technical authority on how our data is structured, how it performs, and how schema changes propagate safely from OLTP to OLAP stores. You'll work closely with application teams, data consumers, and the infrastructure team that operates the CDC pipeline.


What You'll Own

  • OLTP schema design: Data modeling, indexing strategies, migration planning, and performance tuning across multiple database clusters
  • OLAP data modeling: Table design, materialized views, partitioning, and query optimization for analytics workloads
  • Schema evolution: Coordinating schema changes with the infrastructure team to ensure safe propagation through the CDC pipeline
  • Query performance: Profiling, optimization, and capacity planning across both OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Data integrity: Validation, reconciliation, and monitoring to ensure consistency between OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Technical leadership: Standards for schema management, review processes, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration


Tech Stack

  • OLTP: Aurora MySQL 8.0 (multiple clusters, multi-AZ)
  • OLAP: ClickHouse 25.x
  • CDC Pipeline: Debezium 3.3.2 → Kafka 4.0 → ClickHouse
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3)


Requirements

  • 5+ years as a DBA or data engineer, 2+ in a senior/lead role
  • Strong experience with OLTP relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar) — schema design, indexing, query optimization, replication, migrations
  • Strong experience with OLAP/columnar databases (ClickHouse, Vertica, Greenplum, Druid, Doris, or similar) — table design, materialized views, partitioning, query optimization Deep SQL expertise across both transactional and analytical query patterns
  • Experience with schema migration strategies in environments with downstream consumers (CDC, ETL, replication)
  • Familiarity with data consistency challenges between OLTP and OLAP systems



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Debezium or CDC systems — understanding how schema changes affect downstream pipelines
  • Healthcare data or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2)
  • Data quality frameworks — validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection
  • dbt, Airflow, or similar transformation/orchestration tools
  • Performance benchmarking and capacity planning for OLAP databases
  • Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora operational features — Parameter Groups, Performance Insights.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Product Specialist
description:
About the Role:

CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support , Cyber Threat Takedown Operations , and Security Event Analysis . You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools.
  • Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision.
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.


2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.
  • Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms.
  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.


3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.
  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.
  • Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.
  • Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.


Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.
  • Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.
  • Strong communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.
  • Experience with support ticketing tools (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).
  • Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required).
  • Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus.
  • Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish


Working Conditions:

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure).
  • Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).


Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of cybersecurity , AI , and digital risk protection .
  • Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.
  • Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, organização e trabalho em equipe.

title: Calypso Configuration and Environment Management
description:
Project Description:

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Calypso practice.

We are a top-tier Calypso Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade, and migration.

We provide end-to-end project services and have delivered Calypso projects across all major asset classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury, and insurance.


Project Description:

Support and additional build out for a greenfield Calypso instance.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop necessary technical solutions for Calypso environments and instance on the cloud as per requirements
  • Resolve Calypso environment related issues
  • Stabilize Calypso environment with improvements and other services architectural changes
  • Establish a comprehensive and integrated approach to defining, setting up, or trouble shooting issues arising from day-to-day activities on greenfield Calypso instance
  • Create and deliver assigned projects / tasks and revise as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements
  • Competent in managing and establishing methodology and best practice for Calypso technical requirements
  • Ensures supporting documents are complete, current, and appropriately stored
  • Works closely with relevant business and technology stakeholders to ensure effective and efficient implementation of the project(s)
  • Submits status reports to stakeholders; coordinates and provides updates to steering committees
  • Collaboration with key functional or business stakeholders to achieve clear outcomes/deliverables in relation to the strategic and transformational book of work
  • Manage deliverables ensuring transparency of risks, issues and dependencies that are fully aligned to functional / business owners


You might be acting also as a business analyst as well in order to help the team gathering and writing requirements, acceptance criteria.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 5+ years of experience working in Capital Markets and Calypso
  • Environment management, support, and optimization experience on Calypso
  • • Good knowledge of Financial products cross assets
  • • Proven track record of delivery of implementation / migration projects
  • • Proven experience in the development of Calypso integrations, reporting, and other technical aspects
  • Experience of adherence to governance frameworks / implementation and handover to BAU
  • • Comprehensive knowledge of trade flow, trading systems and related concepts and technology, including valuation and client/market risk management
  • • Leadership skills
  • • Excellent analytical skills, understanding of project life cycles, and ability to act in an entrepreneurial manner to ensure the requirements from the business are gathered in the appropriate manner.
  • • Proven analytical, planning, problem solving and decision-making skills
  • • Comfortable with direct communication with all levels of technical and business resources
  • • Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • • Experience with working in a highly collaborative and dynamic multi-team environment


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment is essential.
  • Have a willingness to learn new skills
  • Must have attention to detail
  • Must have the ability to work independently and also as part of a group


  • Experience of Agile practices and processes (e.g. SCRUM, KANBAN)
  • Any technical knowledge (Writing simple sql query, be able to read code )
  • Conflict management ensuring collaborative outcomes
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate
  • Spanish: C2 Proficient

title: Consultor Funcional SAP, Testes, Negócios
description:
CHAMADA ÚNICA – BOOTCAMP SAP CCS|PROGRAMA DE CAPACITAÇÃO


Não perca a oportunidade de fazer parte de um Programa de Capacitação exclusivo para um processo de seleção do BOOTCAMP SAP CCS - Customer Care & Service.

Confira abaixo os detalhes e requisitos mínimos para a sua inscrição:


O que é SAP CCS?

O CCS é a solução da SAP voltada para gestão do ciclo de relacionamento com clientes, muito usada em empresas de Utilities (energia, água, gás, telecom). Ele cobre todo o ciclo de atendimento: do primeiro contato do cliente até faturamento, cobrança e serviços técnicos em campo.


O que é o Bootcamp?

Um programa intensivo de capacitação voltado à formação de consultores SAP.

Requisitos mínimos para participar:

Ter, no mínimo, 3 anos de experiência profissional como:

Analista de negócios com foco em processos de atendimento a cliente em empresas de utilties: cadastro de clientes, faturamento, gestão de ordem de serviço, contas a pagar e a receber.

Analista de TI com experiência em aplicações similares ao SAP CCS no atendimento às empresas de utilities.

Analista de negócio SAP ECC ou S4Hana (Key User) nos módulos CCS em empresa de utilities (água, gás, energia, telecom).

Analista funcional de TI ou consultor funcional SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos SD, FI, PM/PS.

Desenvolvedor SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos CCS, SD, FI, PM/PS com forte base técnica e algum conhecimento funcional destes módulos SAP.


Conhecimentos obrigatórios em pelo menos 2 das 4 áreas abaixo:

Billing: gestão dos diversos ciclos de faturamento por segmento de cliente, geração das faturas/contas, impressão etc

Contract Account: gestão da conta (débitos, créditos, faturas e pagamentos etc) e do contrato com o cliente (Tarifas, datas, status do serviço etc).

Device Management: gestão dos ativos (ex. medidores, locais de instalação). ordens de serviço (instalação, troca, verificação, retirada, histórico etc), leitura de consumo (real, estimada, ajustes)

Sistemas de Informação em Utilities: uso de SAP CCS ou ERPs similares ou custom para empresas do segmento.


Vantagens de participar:

Crescente demanda com a migração para o SAP S/4HANA em empresas de Utilities

Crescimento profissional acelerado e remuneração competitiva

Programa 100% gratuito para os comprometidos

Possibilidade de contratação pela Etho ou parceiros ao final do treinamento


Informações importantes:


Duração: 8 semanas consecutivas, 3 dias por semana: às 2af, 3af, e 5af.

3 horas por sessão, período noturno.


Idioma: não é requerido, mas se tiver aumentam suas chances de participação


Etapas do processo: Triagem|Teste de Raciocínio Lógico|Entrevistas RH e Técnicas


Localização: residir em qualquer lugar do Brasil, preferencialmente para a região de SP, RJ e BH.


Participação: Formação Custeada Integralmente


Se você atende aos requisitos mínimos, envie seu currículo para:

Assunto do e-mail:(Bootcamp SAP CCS)


Vagas limitadas! Não perca essa oportunidade única de transformar sua carreira!

Ative para ver a imagem maior.
