title: Cloud Engineer (US hours)
description:
About the Company


Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a motivated and results-oriented Cloud Engineer with experience in two or more cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) to join our growing team in a support, engineering, and consulting role. In this role, you will work closely with our senior architects, engineers and consultants to assist clients in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in cloud architecture, develop technical expertise, and contribute to the success of our clients.


What You'll Do:


  • Manage and respond to customer-facing support tickets, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with senior architects and consultants to understand client requirements and develop and support scalable cloud-based solutions.
  • Apply best practice framework principles to evaluate and improve client architecture.
  • Apply FinOps best practices to monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud costs, including cost allocation, budget tracking, and implementing cost-saving strategies.
  • Support and assist clients with AI/ML workloads and implementations using cloud provider services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and other AI tools.
  • Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure components such as virtual compute instances (VMs & containers), storage services, databases, and virtual networks (VNet & VPC).
  • Provide technical support to clients, including troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and ensuring security best practices.
  • Configure and manage cloud resources, including virtual compute instances, storage services, databases, virtual networks, and more.
  • Develop and document infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Amazon CloudFormation & CDK, Azure ARM, Azure Bicap, Google Cloud Deployment Manager, or Terraform.
  • Contribute to DevOps workflows using tools such as Azure DevOps, Google Cloud Deployment and Amazon CodePipeline.
  • Maintain awareness and proficiency on cloud services, features, and best practices to provide expert guidance and support to clients.
  • Contribute to the development of documentation, training materials, and best practices guides for internal and external use.
  • Actively participate in professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge of cloud technologies.


What We're Looking For:


  • Bachelor's or Technology degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • At least three years working in an AWS, Azure or Google Cloud environment.
  • At least one professional-level cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.
  • Strong understanding of core cloud provider services, including compute, networking, storage, database, and security.
  • Understanding of AWS, Azure and Google Cloud best practice framework principles and practices.
  • Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization best practices.
  • Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with AI tools and services.
  • Experience with ticketing systems and customer support workflows.
  • Basic knowledge of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.


Bonus Points For:


  • Certifications in more than one cloud provider
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools.
  • Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services.
  • Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews.
  • Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices.
  • Experience in a technology consulting environment.
  • Experience with multiple cloud platforms.


What We Offer:


  • Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for growth and advancement.
  • Exciting projects with leading-edge cloud technologies.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities including training and certification programs.


Join our team and embark on a rewarding career journey as a Cloud Engineer, where you will play a vital role in helping our clients succeed in the cloud. Apply now to become part of our innovative and dynamic team!


Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.


Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at

title: Immigration Attorney (US-licensed)
description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.
  • An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s.
  • Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters.
  • Fluency in a second language is desirable.
  • Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy.

  • Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.


Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.



THE ROLE

The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.

In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.

• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.

• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.

• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.

• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.

• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.

• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.



WHAT IT TAKES

• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.

• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).

• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.

• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.


Be fully aligned to our core values:

• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.

• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.

• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.

• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.

• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.

• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Recruitment Specialist
description:

At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for an experienced and strategic Executive Recruiter to lead end-to-end hiring processes and support corporate talent acquisition for international clients.

This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build a long-term career in Talent Acquisition and HR leadership.


What We Offer


  • Fixed compensation of R$5,000 + bonuses in USD
  • 100% remote, working directly with U.S. teams
  • Monday to Friday, 12PM – 21 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term position
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (Senior Recruiter, Lead, Manager)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Structured training and continuous coaching

Your Responsibilities


  • Manage full-cycle recruitment for corporate and strategic roles
  • Partner with stakeholders to align candidate profiles and hiring needs

  • Utilize tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms

  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused

  • Two monitors

  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone
  • Quiet home office


Build your international career in Recruitment.


Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

title: Cloud Engineer (US hours)
description:
About the Company


Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a motivated and results-oriented Cloud Engineer with experience in two or more cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) to join our growing team in a support, engineering, and consulting role. In this role, you will work closely with our senior architects, engineers and consultants to assist clients in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in cloud architecture, develop technical expertise, and contribute to the success of our clients.


What You'll Do:


  • Manage and respond to customer-facing support tickets, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with senior architects and consultants to understand client requirements and develop and support scalable cloud-based solutions.
  • Apply best practice framework principles to evaluate and improve client architecture.
  • Apply FinOps best practices to monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud costs, including cost allocation, budget tracking, and implementing cost-saving strategies.
  • Support and assist clients with AI/ML workloads and implementations using cloud provider services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and other AI tools.
  • Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure components such as virtual compute instances (VMs & containers), storage services, databases, and virtual networks (VNet & VPC).
  • Provide technical support to clients, including troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and ensuring security best practices.
  • Configure and manage cloud resources, including virtual compute instances, storage services, databases, virtual networks, and more.
  • Develop and document infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Amazon CloudFormation & CDK, Azure ARM, Azure Bicap, Google Cloud Deployment Manager, or Terraform.
  • Contribute to DevOps workflows using tools such as Azure DevOps, Google Cloud Deployment and Amazon CodePipeline.
  • Maintain awareness and proficiency on cloud services, features, and best practices to provide expert guidance and support to clients.
  • Contribute to the development of documentation, training materials, and best practices guides for internal and external use.
  • Actively participate in professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge of cloud technologies.


What We're Looking For:


  • Bachelor's or Technology degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • At least three years working in an AWS, Azure or Google Cloud environment.
  • At least one professional-level cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.
  • Strong understanding of core cloud provider services, including compute, networking, storage, database, and security.
  • Understanding of AWS, Azure and Google Cloud best practice framework principles and practices.
  • Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization best practices.
  • Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with AI tools and services.
  • Experience with ticketing systems and customer support workflows.
  • Basic knowledge of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.


Bonus Points For:


  • Certifications in more than one cloud provider
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools.
  • Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services.
  • Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews.
  • Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices.
  • Experience in a technology consulting environment.
  • Experience with multiple cloud platforms.


What We Offer:


  • Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for growth and advancement.
  • Exciting projects with leading-edge cloud technologies.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities including training and certification programs.


Join our team and embark on a rewarding career journey as a Cloud Engineer, where you will play a vital role in helping our clients succeed in the cloud. Apply now to become part of our innovative and dynamic team!


Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.


Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at

description:

About the Role

We’re building next-gen AI systems that actually understand football — not just scores, but tactics, history, formations, transfers, and match context. That’s where you come in.

description:
Código da vaga: 58715


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um(a) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência com testes manuais e boas práticas de QA.
  • Automação em Java com Selenium e Cucumber (front-end).

  • Conhecimento em SQL Server e uso do DBeaver .
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis .
  • Noções de AWS .
  • Familiaridade com o segmento financeiro (muito importante).



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for an experienced FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer to join a project focused on expanding and enhancing the Performance Monitoring Counters (PMC) validation test suite for modern platforms.

The goal of the project is to strengthen the reliability and coverage of FreeBSD's performance monitoring frameworks across core, uncore, and IBS PMCs.

You will be responsible for creating new validation tests, improving existing ones, ensuring correct PMC multiplexing behavior, and enabling proper PMC attachment to live processes in FreeBSD environments.


This role involves close work with low-level system internals, performance instrumentation, and automated test development.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and enhance the PMC validation test suite on FreeBSD for modern platforms
  • Validate core, uncore, and IBS performance monitoring counters
  • Validate PMC multiplexing on FreeBSD
  • Validate proper PMC attach functionality to existing processes
  • Design and automate test scenarios across various performance monitoring frameworks
  • Collaborate with kernel engineers to analyze results, identify issues, and propose fixes or improvements
  • Maintain documentation, test plans, and validation reports
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of automation frameworks and test coverage


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience
  • Hands-on experience with modern Unix/Linux kernel validation (FreeBSD kernel validation is a strong bonus)
  • Strong understanding of performance management frameworks (e.g., PMCs, perf, hardware performance counters)
  • Solid understanding of x86 architecture, especially performance monitoring hardware
  • Excellent automation and scripting skills (Python, Shell, or similar)
  • Experience designing and implementing automated test cases for performance monitoring frameworks
  • Ability to work with low-level debugging, instrumentation, and system performance tools


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Oracle EBS O2C Functional Consultant
description:
Job Title: Oracle EBS O2C Functional Consultant

Location: Brazil Remote

Duration: Nearshore / Contract


Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Oracle EBS O2C (Order to Cash) Functional Consultant with strong expertise in Oracle E-Business Suite Financials and Order Management modules. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in end-to-end O2C cycle implementation and support, with added knowledge of Brazil tax regulations and localization requirements.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement, configure, and support Oracle EBS O2C modules including Order Management (OM), Accounts Receivable (AR), Advanced Pricing, and Inventory.
  • Manage end-to-end O2C cycle: Order Entry → Shipping → Invoicing → Receivables → Collections → Cash Application.
  • Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into functional specifications.
  • Work closely with technical teams for RICEFW objects (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Extensions, Forms, Workflows).
  • Support month-end and year-end financial closing activities related to AR and revenue recognition.
  • Provide production support and resolve functional issues.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Finance, Supply Chain, and Tax.


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience as an Oracle EBS Functional Consultant.
  • Strong hands-on experience in O2C modules (OM, AR, Pricing, Shipping, Inventory) .
  • Experience in at least one full lifecycle implementation.
  • Good understanding of accounting principles and AR processes.
  • Experience in writing functional design documents (FDDs).
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Brazil tax localization , including knowledge of Brazil tax laws (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS).
  • Familiarity with Brazil fiscal reporting, Nota Fiscal (NF-e), and local statutory compliance requirements.
  • Experience working with global or LATAM implementations.

title: Elementor Expert (WordPress eCom Website Builder)
description:
We are looking for a skilled WordPress developer with strong Elementor experience to join our team and build high-performance websites for our marketing agency clients.


This role focuses on executing a proven build process , not designing sites from scratch. You’ll work from established Elementor Pro templates while inserting pre-generated content and images created by our internal AI systems.


If you enjoy working within clear systems and take pride in building clean, fast, and polished websites , this role will be a great fit.


Responsibilities


  • Build 3–4 WordPress websites per week using pre-built Elementor Pro templates
  • Insert AI-generated content into website layouts (all content is provided)
  • Adjust layouts and design elements to tailor each template for the client
  • Generate website visuals using AI image tools based on supplied prompts
  • Create simple design assets when needed using Canva
  • Integrate WooCommerce functionality for ecommerce websites
  • Ensure each website achieves extremely fast page load speeds (under 1 second)
  • Follow documented build processes and workflows precisely


Required Skills & Experience


  • Advanced proficiency with Elementor and Elementor Pro
  • Strong knowledge of WordPress performance optimization
  • Experience configuring WooCommerce within Elementor websites
  • Familiarity with AI image generation tools (Midjourney, DALL-E, OpenAI, etc.)
  • Basic graphic design ability and experience with Canva
  • Strong English communication skills
  • Available during EST business hours
  • Highly organized and comfortable working within defined processes


What This Role Focuses On


This role is about efficiently producing high-quality websites using a repeatable system .


You will not be responsible for writing content or designing full websites from scratch. Our automation tools generate the text and provide prompts for images. Your job is to assemble the site using templates, produce visuals, refine the layout, and ensure the final result is clean, professional, and extremely fast.


Important Note


⚡ Performance is critical.

Every site must achieve full page load speeds under 1 second without relying on caching solutions.


If you do not have strong experience optimizing WordPress for speed, this role will not be a good fit.


What We Provide


  • Managed hosting accounts
  • Elementor Pro licenses
  • AI-generated content for every site
  • Image prompts for generating visuals
  • Detailed documentation and build processes
  • A steady pipeline of website projects


Full-time role

Working hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (±1 hour flexibility)


Who We’re Looking For


The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, efficient, and process-driven . You take pride in producing polished work, enjoy following clear systems, and understand how small optimizations can dramatically impact website performance.


You’re comfortable using modern tools like AI image generators, you work quickly without sacrificing quality, and you care about delivering websites that are both visually clean and technically fast .

  • Olhar crítico para identidade visual e revisão de peças (texto e design);

Diferenciais

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Talent Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**

Full-time position.

Pay is $8-$10 per hour paid in USD.


Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.

Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.


Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software

Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals


Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Network Associate (Hunter)
description:
Network Associate (Hunter)


A Trust Insight é uma empresa que atua na economia de insights e de conhecimento especializado, com sede em São Paulo, Brasil. Nossa missão é simples: fornecer os melhores especialistas em determinados temas para ajudar nossos clientes a tomar decisões de investimento mais assertivas. Com nossa ampla base de especialistas de classe mundial, nossos clientes recebem respostas valiosas às suas dúvidas sobre indústria e negócios. Nossos clientes são bancos de investimento e consultorias no Brasil e no exterior. Como parte de nossos esforços de crescimento, estamos em busca de um(a) Network Associate excelente para trabalhar de perto com nosso time atual e manter contato diário com nossos valiosos especialistas.


Como Network Associate, você será responsável por fortalecer, ampliar e ativar nossa rede de especialistas. Você terá um papel fundamental na identificação proativa de especialistas relevantes, antecipando as necessidades dos clientes e garantindo que nossa rede permaneça altamente engajada e atualizada.


Essa função exige forte proatividade, conhecimento de mercado e habilidades de relacionamento, além da capacidade de identificar oportunidades e transformá-las em engajamento qualificado de especialistas.


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar pesquisas para identificar e recrutar especialistas de diversos setores
  • Apoiar o time antecipando necessidades dos clientes e sugerindo proativamente especialistas e temas relevantes

  • Interagir com especialistas para validar sua expertise e alinhar temas relevantes de mercado
  • Negociar com especialistas quanto à remuneração
  • Reativar especialistas inativos na rede e manter relacionamentos contínuos e sólidos
  • Monitorar tendências de mercado, notícias de empresas e principais desenvolvimentos da indústria para identificar oportunidades de abordagem proativa
  • Colaborar de perto com o time de Research para melhorar a cobertura e a agilidade da rede de especialistas
  • Auxiliar e acompanhar na preparação e realização de reuniões
  • Melhorar continuamente as estratégias de sourcing e contribuir para a expansão da base de especialistas


Buscamos alguém que

  • Possui forte capacidade de pesquisa e recrutamento (“hunting”)
  • Demonstre alta proatividade e senso de dono
  • Tenha excelentes habilidades interpessoais e de comunicação
  • Seja altamente organizado(a), atento(a) aos detalhes e capaz de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades
  • Tenha forte interesse por negócios, mercados e dinâmicas de indústria
  • Se desenvolva bem em um ambiente dinâmico e de alta performance
  • Seja curioso(a), motivado(a) e com vontade de aprender


Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo
  • Inglês intermediário (espanhol é um diferencial)
  • Forte iniciativa e motivação para expandir a rede
  • Habilidade de relacionamento e facilidade natural para construir conexões
  • Experiência em recrutamento, pesquisa ou funções similares é um diferencial
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação (escrita e verbal) em inglês e português
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão, com prazos apertados e altas expectativas


Informações adicionais

title: Football Expert
description:
Job Title: AI Trainer – Football (Soccer) Expert

Location: Remote

Fill up this form-


About the Role

We’re building next-gen AI systems that actually understand football — not just scores, but tactics, history, formations, transfers, and match context. That’s where you come in.

As an AI Trainer – Football Expert , you’ll help train and evaluate AI models by working on football-related queries, ensuring responses are accurate, insightful, and game-smart. Think less “Wikipedia vibes,” more “football brain.”

What You’ll Do

  • Review and respond to football-related queries used to train AI models
  • Evaluate AI-generated answers for accuracy, depth, and football logic
  • Create high-quality sample responses (“golden answers”)
  • Improve prompts and datasets related to football knowledge
  • Validate facts around leagues, players, tactics, history, and match analysis
  • Ensure outputs sound natural, clear, and expert-level

What We’re Looking For

  • Deep football knowledge (club & international football)
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Tactics, formations, and playing styles
  • Major leagues (EPL, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1)
  • International tournaments (World Cup, Euros, Copa, AFCON, etc.)
  • Experience as a:
  • Football analyst
  • Coach / former player
  • Sports journalist / content creator
  • Scout or data analyst
  • Excellent written English (clear, structured, no waffle)
  • Comfortable reviewing and improving AI-generated content

O desafio envolve lidar com regras de negócio críticas, como processamento de corte, encargos, consolidação de informações e transição de sistemas legados, em um ecossistema que integra Mendix , Golang e APIs de alta performance.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Modelagem de Domínio: Criar e gerenciar entidades, associações e atributos complexos no modelo de domínio.

  • Arquitetura e Decisões Técnicas: Definir arquitetura da aplicação (monolito x modular), separação por domínios e tomar decisões de trade-off entre performance, sustentação e prazo.
  • Padronização: Criar e seguir padrões de projeto para microflows, naming, segurança e páginas.
  • Integrações e Performance: Integrar com APIs externas e serviços web, além de antecipar problemas de escalabilidade e otimizar o desempenho do sistema para grandes volumes de transações.
  • Qualidade: Depurar aplicações e criar testes automatizados para garantir a estabilidade do código em produção.
  • Documentação: Manter a documentação técnica clara e concisa para a evolução do sistema.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de aplicações com a plataforma Mendix .

title: Immigration Attorney (US-licensed)
description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.

title: Médico Especialista em Demência – Papel Consultivo (Dedicação Parcial)
description:
Sobre a Kuidar+

A Kuidar+ está desenvolvendo um modelo estruturado de coordenação de cuidados em demência , apoiado por tecnologia, para famílias que convivem com Alzheimer e outras demências no Brasil.

Nosso programa atua entre as consultas médicas , oferecendo monitoramento contínuo, suporte ao cuidador, coordenação de telemedicina e navegação estruturada do cuidado. A plataforma combina protocolos clínicos, ferramentas digitais, telemonitoramento e apoio baseado em inteligência artificial para ajudar famílias a lidar com os desafios médicos, comportamentais e práticos da demência.

O modelo é inspirado em iniciativas internacionais de coordenação de cuidado em demência, como o GUIDE Model (EUA) , adaptado ao contexto brasileiro.

Estamos atualmente em fase piloto , construindo o primeiro modelo operacional do programa e formando o primeiro Care Pod da Kuidar+.


Sobre a função

Buscamos um médico(a) com experiência em demência para atuar como Médico Advisor da Kuidar+ em regime de dedicação parcial.

Esta não é uma posição assistencial e não envolve consultas ou atendimento médico direto aos pacientes.


O papel combina dois objetivos principais:


Governança clínica

Apoiar a validação clínica do modelo de cuidado, garantindo que protocolos, critérios de triagem e fluxos de segurança estejam alinhados às melhores práticas no cuidado de pessoas com demência.


Desenvolvimento do modelo de cuidado

Contribuir para o desenho e evolução do modelo de coordenação de cuidados da Kuidar+, incluindo o uso de telemedicina, monitoramento remoto e ferramentas baseadas em inteligência artificial .

O profissional poderá ser apresentado publicamente como Clinical Advisor da Kuidar+ , contribuindo para a construção da arquitetura clínica do programa.

Com a evolução da empresa, poderá também participar de discussões estratégicas relacionadas ao desenvolvimento clínico da plataforma e do modelo de cuidado .


Responsabilidades

  • Revisar e validar protocolos clínicos utilizados no programa
  • Contribuir para a definição de critérios de triagem e escalonamento clínico
  • Oferecer orientação à equipe multidisciplinar em situações clínicas mais complexas
  • Participar de revisões periódicas de casos
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento do modelo de cuidado e das estruturas de segurança clínica


Dedicação

Aproximadamente 2–4 horas por semana , com atuação predominantemente remota.

A colaboração poderá iniciar em formato pontual por advisory , com possibilidade de evolução para retainer mensal conforme o programa se desenvolva.


Requisitos

  • Médico(a) com especialização em Geriatria, Neurologia ou área relacionada
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência clínica
  • Experiência no cuidado de pacientes com demência, Alzheimer ou transtornos cognitivos
  • Capacidade de colaborar em ambiente multidisciplinar
  • Conforto para comunicação em inglês

title: Director of Marketing | Hotel Technology Experience Required
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next-generation, AI-native platform for the hospitality industry. Looking for a Director of Marketing who understands hotels, understands technology, and knows how to turn that knowledge into real growth.


This role is ideal for someone who has marketed to hotel decision-makers before and enjoys building campaigns, writing compelling content, and generating measurable demand.


About the Role

We’re building something special for the hotel industry, and we’re looking for a Director of Marketing who feels at home in the world of hotel technology.


If you’ve spent meaningful time marketing to hoteliers, understand how hotel decision-makers think, and enjoy rolling up your sleeves to create campaigns that drive pipeline, you’ll thrive in this role.


This is a hands-on, full-funnel leadership role responsible for building and scaling our marketing engine. You will oversee demand generation, product marketing, content creation, and go-to-market strategy while working closely with Sales to drive qualified leads and revenue growth.


The hospitality industry values clarity, trust, and solutions that make operations easier. We’re looking for someone who knows how to communicate exactly that.


What You’ll Be Doing

Develop a deep understanding of the hotel ecosystem, including independent hotels, management companies, and brand-affiliated properties.


Stay closely connected to the needs and priorities of hotel decision-makers such as:

  • General Managers
  • Directors of Sales and Marketing
  • Revenue Managers
  • Digital marketing leaders
  • IT leaders


Use these insights to shape messaging, positioning, and campaigns that resonate with hotel operators.


Owning the Marketing Engine

Build and manage the full marketing funnel—from awareness through lead generation, nurturing, and conversion to sales.


Key areas include:

  • Demand generation strategy
  • SEO and digital acquisition
  • Email and lifecycle marketing
  • Webinars and industry events
  • Campaign development and execution


Your goal is to ensure marketing consistently generates qualified pipeline for the sales team.


Leading Blog and Thought Leadership Strategy

Own and grow the company’s blog and thought leadership presence to establish authority in the hospitality technology space and drive inbound demand.


This includes:

  • Writing and overseeing blog content focused on hotel industry trends and insights
  • Creating thought leadership around topics like AI in hospitality, guest engagement, and direct booking strategies
  • Developing SEO-driven blog content that attracts hotel decision-makers researching solutions
  • Implement AI Engine Optimization (AEO) strategies to ensure the company and its content are discoverable through AI agents like Copilot, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other emerging AI-driven discovery platforms.
  • Repurposing blog content into campaigns, posts, webinars, and sales materials


Creating Content That Speaks the Hotel Industry’s Language

Develop and oversee content that resonates with hospitality leaders, including:

  • Blog articles and thought leadership pieces
  • Industry guides and educational resources
  • Case studies and ROI stories
  • Campaign messaging and landing pages
  • Sales enablement materials


The goal is content that feels authentic, practical, and directly relevant to hotel operators , while positioning the company as a trusted voice in hospitality technology.


Becoming Deeply Fluent in the Product

You will develop strong product knowledge and become fluent in how the platform works.


This includes understanding:

  • How the product integrates into the hotel technology stack
  • The operational problems it solves for hotel teams
  • The value it creates for revenue growth and guest engagement


This fluency will help shape messaging, positioning, and product launches.


Partnering Closely with Sales

Marketing and sales alignment is critical in this role.


You will work closely with the sales team to:

  • Align on pipeline and growth targets
  • Develop campaigns that generate qualified opportunities
  • Support sales with content, messaging, and materials
  • Continuously improve lead quality and funnel performance


Using Data to Drive Decisions

Track performance across the funnel and continuously improve marketing efficiency.


You will analyze:

  • Lead generation performance
  • Campaign ROI
  • Funnel conversion metrics
  • Customer acquisition trends


Marketing should be measurable, predictable, and scalable.


Success in This Role

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to build a scalable marketing engine that consistently generates qualified pipeline.


Key outcomes include:

  • Growth in marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline
  • Consistent generation of qualified leads for the sales team
  • Increased inbound demand through SEO, blog content, and thought leadership
  • Strong campaign performance across webinars, events, and digital channels
  • Clear and compelling positioning that resonates with hotel decision-makers


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience marketing to hotels or within the hospitality technology ecosystem
  • Experience in B2B SaaS marketing and demand generation
  • Proven ability to generate qualified pipeline and measurable revenue impact
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, including blogs and thought leadership content
  • Ability to translate complex technology into clear, compelling messaging
  • Comfort operating both strategically and hands-on
  • Experience collaborating closely with sales teams in a pipeline-driven environment
  • Interest in AI-driven platforms, automation, and emerging technology transforming hospitality


Experience at or working with hospitality technology platforms such as hotel CRM, guest engagement, marketing automation, revenue management, or hotel operations platforms is highly valued.


Why You Might Love This Role

You enjoy understanding how an industry works and building marketing that speaks directly to it.


You like owning the entire marketing engine , not just one channel.


You enjoy turning insight, content, and campaigns into measurable growth.


You want to help shape how the hospitality industry adopts the next generation of technology.


Why Join Us

You’ll be joining a modern AI-native product company that is helping reshape how hotels understand their guests, grow direct bookings, and operate more intelligently.


This is a rare opportunity to help introduce AI-powered guest engagement and marketing technology to the hospitality industry while building a marketing engine that drives real growth.


Your work will directly influence:

  • How the industry understands our product
  • How we position ourselves in the market
  • How we generate scalable demand


You won’t just run campaigns—you’ll help define how a new category of hospitality technology is introduced to the market and adopted by hotel leaders around the world.


If you’re energized by hospitality, great products, and building a marketing engine that truly moves the needle, we’d love to meet you.

Pioneira no país em gestão de serviços oncológicos, a Oncoclínicas&Co foi fundada em 2010 e hoje é um dos maiores centros de oncologia, hematologia e radioterapia da América Latina.

Na essência da Oncoclínicas&Co , o paciente é o centro de tudo. É para ele que buscamos os mais avançados tratamentos e o mais alto nível de qualidade e segurança. Temos como pilares de atuação o acolhimento e a inovação no tratamento oncológico e a atenção integral e personalizada, com um olhar no indivíduo.

Aqui na Oncoclínicas&Co valorizamos a diversidade e buscamos promover uma cultura inclusiva onde as pessoas se sintam pertencentes. Acreditamos que a inovação nasce de um ambiente diverso, com diferentes perspectivas e vivências.

O que você irá fazer:

Responsável pela elaboração dos controles e chamados para o pagamento do Carreira Médica; controle e elaboração, junto a área financeira, do fechamento mensal das parcerias (CIME e Pilar); elaboração de contratos (contratação de médicos, locações, parcerias e outros); Apoio para as áreas administrativas (facilities e ciclo da conta); apoiar o Coordenador Administrativo em qualquer necessidade.

O que você precisa ter:

• Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas ou áreas correlatas;

• Experiência em carreira médica, elaboração de contratos, facilities e ciclo da conta.

• Pacote office intermediário.


Local e horário de trabalho:


IHOC - Curitiba


• Segunda a quinta 08:00 18:00 e sexta 08:00 às 17:00


O que oferecemos:

Pesando em seu desenvolvimento, oferecemos o PROGRAMA MAIS SABER – que proporciona descontos, conforme rede conveniada, em instituições de ensino superior e escolas de idiomas


Para contribuir com sua saúde oferecemos o Clude saúde – uma central de saúde que oferece telepsicologia, orientação médica, nutricional, acompanhamento do pré-natal de gestantes e teleatendimento médico.


Somos uma empresa da área de saúde e preocupados em seu bem-estar, oferecemos o PLANO DE SAÚDE e o PLANO ODONTOLÓGICO.

É claro que também temos um SEGURO DE VIDA que cobre as doenças ocupacionais.


Pensando em contribuir com sua refeição na hora do almoço, oferecemos o VALE REFEIÇÃO

Para o seu salário render mais temos a ALLYA – plataforma de descontos.


E para se manter saudável, disponibilizamos o GYMPASS.


No mês do seu aniversário a Oncoclinicas&Co te presenteia com o DAY OFF , um dia de folga sem prejuízo na remuneração.


E para finalizar, nada mais justo do que dividir uma porcentagem do lucro com quem trabalhou por cada realização, não é mesmo? Então, se a Oncoclinicas&Co tem lucro você recebe uma grana a mais em nosso PROGRAMA DE LUCROS E RESULTADOS.

title: Arquiteto de soluções Azure/IA
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Arquiteto de soluções Azure/IA


Descrição:


Estamos procurando um(a) Arquiteto de soluções Azure/IA para ajudar clientes a levar suas aplicações com IA para escala de produção no Azure. Nessa função voltada ao cliente, você liderará engajamentos técnicos em design, construção e operações, removendo impedimentos e acelerando a adoção de Azure AI, App Services, GitHub e plataformas de dados. Como parte da equipe Cloud + AI Apps, você conduzirá engajamentos aproveitando IP Repetível e mecanismos de execução existentes, com responsabilidade por excelência na entrega, crescimento de consumo e implantação bem-sucedida para o cliente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Interagir com líderes de TI e de negócios do cliente para entender as prioridades de aplicações, dados e IA, e desenhar soluções seguras e escaláveis que gerem valor de negócio e satisfação do cliente.
  • Estar credenciado(a) e certificado(a) para entregar com proficiência avançada e de nível especialista em cargas de trabalho prioritárias, incluindo Azure AI Foundry, AKS, App Service, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, APIM e GitHub.
  • Liderar engajamentos técnicos em design de arquitetura, Provas de Conceito (POCs) e Produtos Mínimos Viáveis (MVPs) para acelerar a adoção de Azure AI, App Services, GitHub e plataformas de dados.
  • Ser responsável pelos resultados de entrega técnica ponta a ponta, garantindo completude e precisão dos planos de consumo e de sucesso do cliente em colaboração com o CSAM.
  • Conduzir as próximas melhores ações e gerar pipeline incremental a partir de cada engajamento, alinhando-se às prioridades do Unified Enterprise Support (ES).
  • Entregar propriedade intelectual (IP) reutilizável e contribuir para o desenvolvimento centralizado de IP para acelerar a implantação e alcançar os resultados-alvo.
  • Fornecer supervisão de entrega e suporte a escalonamentos (escalation) para engajamentos-chave de Factory em projetos de IA e de Inovação em Apps.
  • Atuar como a Voz do Cliente, compartilhando insights e feedback com as equipes de engenharia para influenciar melhorias de produto e remover impedimentos à adoção.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de competências do cliente por meio de workshops técnicos, atividades de readiness e recomendações que garantam desempenho, manutenibilidade e confiabilidade da solução.
  • Manter profunda expertise técnica e permanecer atualizado(a) sobre tendências de desenvolvimento no Azure, IA, GitHub e cloud-native, contribuindo também para comunidades técnicas internas e externas.


Contratação CLT
